summary: Argentina beat Paraguay 1-0 in CONMEBOL World Cup qualifying at Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires, thanks to Nicolas Otamendi's fourth-minute goal. Argentina dominated but wasted many chances, with Lionel Messi hitting the post twice after coming on at 53'. Emiliano Martinez set a national team record of 609 minutes without conceding, and Daniel Garnero made his debut as Paraguay manager.
one_line: Argentina beat Paraguay 1-0 in World Cup qualifying through an early Otamendi goal, dominating but wasting chances, as Emiliano Martinez extended his record shutout streak.
key_facts: Argentina beat Paraguay 1-0 at Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires in CONMEBOL World Cup qualifying; the only goal was Nicolas Otamendi's volley in the 4th minute from a Rodrigo de Paul corner.
The win put Argentina on nine points from a possible nine to start World Cup qualifying.
Emiliano Martinez set an Argentine national team record of 609 minutes without conceding; Argentina have not conceded since Kylian Mbappe's 118th-minute equalizer in the 2022 World Cup final.
Lionel Scaloni has still never lost a World Cup qualifier as Argentina head coach.
Lionel Messi started on the bench and came on for Julian Alvarez at 53', hitting the post twice, once directly from a corner (77') and once with a free-kick (90+2').
Rodrigo de Paul hit the post in the 42nd minute; Alexis Mac Allister had a penalty appeal waved away with no VAR intervention in the 36th minute.
At halftime Argentina led possession 74% to 26%, shots 10 to 2 and shots on target 4 to 0, according to OptaJavier.
Lautaro Martinez and Julian Alvarez started together for Argentina for the first time; Lautaro was on an 11-match scoreless streak for the national team.
Daniel Garnero, a 54-year-old Argentine, made his debut as Paraguay's permanent manager after two years at Libertad, replacing Guillermo Barros Schelotto.
Antonio Sanabria reportedly spat on Messi in the 86th minute; the officials missed it.
Junior Alonso was stretchered off in the 75th minute after receiving a yellow card in the 21st minute; Antonio Bareiro was booked at 50' for a dramatic fall.
Adam Bareiro earned his debut cap as Paraguay striker, in place of Gabriel Avalos, and Carlos Coronel started in goal.
Angel Di Maria, Paulo Dybala and Juan Foyth withdrew from Argentina's squad through injury, and Lisandro Martinez was unavailable after a foot operation.
Messi's club Inter Miami were eliminated from MLS playoff contention after a 1-0 loss to FC Cincinnati, leaving him only international breaks until February.
